PART III

PART III.
PAPER BALLOT VOTING SYSTEM

Note

Part heading amended by L 1975, c 36, §5(3).

§16-21 Definition. "Paper ballot
voting system" means the method of recording votes which are counted
manually. [L 1970, c 26, pt of §2; am L 1975, c 36, §5(4)]
